messages:
maya: hey team — first day question: I need to run the SDK e2e for feature flags. Can someone create a service account and grant Console staging + feature-flag admin role? I need a token for CI (ttl 7d). cc @devops-sig

sanjay: welcome! congrats on joining 🙌. what's the service account name you want? staging only or do you need prod perms too?

maya: staging only to start. prefer name: maya-ff-ci. CI job is github-actions/release/ff-e2e. just need read/write toggles in staging, no prod.

tina: @sanjay I can handle the staging svc acct. tagging infra-bot to provision. confirm ttl?

maya: 7d is fine — we'll rotate automatically. also need a quick note on how to add the token to GH secrets.

infra-bot: Service account creation request received: request_id=SRV-4521. Provisioning in progress.

sanjay: fyi — ff-admin role gives toggle + rollout + audit view. for GH secrets use name REDWOOD_FF_SA_TOKEN in repo settings (Actions -> Secrets -> New repository secret).

maya: sample snippet I can use to read it in the job?

maya: ```bash
export REDWOOD_FF_SA_TOKEN="$REDWOOD_FF_SA_TOKEN"
# then pass to e2e runner
```

tina: created service account maya-ff-ci in staging, attached role ff-admin, ttl 7d. token uploaded to ticket SRV-4521 (private). @maya I'll DM you the token and add a note with rotation date. Prod access requires manager approval + security review.

maya: got the DM with token, thanks! quick question — can we restrict the token to a single flag? we only want programmatic access to 'exp_search_routing'.

sanjay: good question. Console flags are namespaced by project. You can restrict via a scoped token: scope=flags:exp_search_routing. Open a ticket to request scoped tokens (include request_id and desired flag). Otherwise use targeting rules in Console (UI -> Flags -> Targeting) to limit who sees the flag.

maya: perfect, will open a ticket if we need the scoped token. thanks everyone :party_parrot:
